1168-1479-2841-3318.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1168-1479-2841-3318.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2073-6797-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-6797-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3967-4871-5220-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3967-4871-5220-7806.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

206-2366-3322-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-2366-3322-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

277-774-3756.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Izzet Boilerworks's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-774-3756.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

1171-1409-7060.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

560-1274-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-1274-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

1739-2421-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

934-1399-1606-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
934-1399-1606-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2732-5231-6132.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

628-997-2018.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that is not a Human and does not have flying.
628-997-2018.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

11-3617-3942-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-3617-3942-6276.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Time Walk.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Time Walk, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-3617-3942-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Karador this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

643-1429-3698-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-3698-5402.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

372-2493-3306.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Archaeomancer exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
372-2493-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1329-1750-2793-2921-5261.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2665-2743-2751.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Progenitor Mimic's trigger.
Resolve both triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1283-2440-4082.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Cats.
1283-2440-4082.description:
Activate Kemba by paying {5}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token.
The Cat enters the battlefield, triggering Kemba and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Kemba trigger, allowing you to attach an Equipment to the Cat token.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

669-1506-3238.notablePrerequisites:
Phyrexian Colossus does not have summoning sickness.
Lifelink and Burning Anger attached to Phyrexian Colossus.
669-1506-3238.description:
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by tapping it, dealing 8 damage to any target and causing you to gain eight life.
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by paying eight life, untapping it.
Repeat.

4447-4741.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Merchant Ship.
A player controls no Islands.
4447-4741.description:
If needed, give control of Merchant Ship to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Merchant Ship's controller controls no Islands, Merchant Ship triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Merchant Ship cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Merchant Ship triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

628-2034-3108.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
628-2034-3108.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

231-2104-3200-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
231-2104-3200-4423.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at a random card in target player's hand and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand, returning Urza's Bauble from graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Urza's Bauble triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

32-1271-3212.description:
Tap Scroll Rack and pay {1} to activate it, putting Temporal Trespass on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Temporal Trespass, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {6}{U}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
